name: Zombie Showgirls
prompt: A troupe of showgirls in tattered feathered headdresses shambles out from behind a burned-out marquee, glittering costumes crusted with ash and dried blood. Their choreography is dead-eyed and perfectly synchronized, high kicks landing in unison as they close the distance. The lead showgirl's smile never wavers, even as her jaw hangs slack.

name: The King's Cult
prompt: A procession of white-jumpsuited cultists shuffles down the median chanting a warped hymn to 'The King', led by a bloated priest in oversized sunglasses and a corpse-pale cape. They carry a rhinestone-studded coffin they insist is 'just resting'. If approached, they demand tribute — or a duet.

name: Sentient Slot Machine
prompt: A single slot machine on the ruined casino floor hums with cold blue light, its reels spinning of their own accord. It speaks in a chorus of dial tones and jackpot bells, offering to 'settle all debts' for anyone who pulls its lever. Coins pour from its mouth like teeth when it's angry.

name: Ghoul Valet
prompt: A ghoul in a stained red valet vest waves the party down from behind a rusted podium, offering to 'park' any vehicle for a modest toll of teeth or memories. He is unfailingly polite, complimenting everyone's shoes even as flies orbit his head. He knows every shortcut through the Strip's ruins.

name: Radioactive Flamingo Flock
prompt: A flock of radioactive flamingos wheels overhead, feathers glowing a sickly green, before diving at the party with beaks sharp as can openers. They screech in a pitch that rattles fillings and scatter irradiated dust with every wingbeat. Individually weak, they attack in overwhelming numbers.

name: The Chapel Bell Toll
prompt: A cracked bell tolls from a half-collapsed wedding chapel steeple, though no one is pulling the rope — the sound rolls across the Strip like a held breath. Every undead within earshot pauses mid-stride, heads tilting toward the sound in eerie reverence. When it stops, something answers from underground.

name: Looter Standoff
prompt: Three ragged survivors have a jeweler's case wedged open at gunpoint, arguing over a haul of watches and rings that won't buy anything anyone still needs. They rounded on the party the moment they noticed movement, nerves shot and triggers itchy. A wrong word could turn this into a firefight — or a truce.

name: Sinkhole to the Understreets
prompt: The asphalt groans and buckles, opening a jagged sinkhole that exhales cold air smelling of tallow and old pennies — a way down into the understreets beneath the Strip. Something down there is dragging chains across stone, patient and unseen. The hole isn't going anywhere; whether the party climbs down is another matter.
